title: Pseudonymization Proposal
summary: A research-backed design proposal document set for a pseudonymization layer at an enterprise data platform, covering technique selection, architecture, key management, and Korean PIPA compliance rather than implementation code. Its ML pipeline integration document recommends SDV's HMASynthesizer (alongside CTGAN or TVAE) as a tool for generating fully synthetic relational training data to eliminate re-identification risk.
evidence: docs/07-ml-pipeline.md:121 "`sdv.multi_table.HMASynthesizer` for relational schemas" — recommended in a design proposal, no code
